description: PromptAssembler — 10-section ordered template with stage-specific formatting and truncation policy
negotiation_notes: AC4/AC6/AC18: exact ADR §Q3 section header strings including stage suffix on Hard/Soft Rules and (top N of M) on Candidate Summary
AC18 (new): Problem Statement body matches ADR example (Title/Description/Extracted files/keywords), not nested to_prompt_text() header
AC10: explicit examined/unexamined selection by rank order; files_changed comma-space joined
AC9: required stage-instruction substrings from ADR examples (testable without LLM)
AC11: FIFO evidence removal; truncation cascade targets match ADR (evidence → candidates top-10 → skills top-1); protected sections explicit
AC19 (new): seed-data integration test without mocks for load_rules/retrieve_skills wiring
AC15: corrected import paths (relative .rules/.skills or models/extraction, not self-import governance)
Edge cases E7–E10 added for None state/brief, zero examined attribution, empty problem statement

acceptance_criteria.description: New module src/commit_investigator/governance/prompt_assembler.py. governance/__init__.py additionally exports: assemble_prompt, PromptConfig.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Import test: from commit_investigator.governance import assemble_prompt, PromptConfig

acceptance_criteria.description: PromptConfig dataclass with fields: token_budget (int, default=100_000), truncation_threshold (float, default=0.80), candidate_limit_stage2 (int, default=20), candidate_limit_stage3_unexamined (int, default=5), max_skills (int, default=3). All numeric fields must be > 0; otherwise ValueError on construction.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: default construction has expected values; override token_budget=50_000 works; token_budget=0 raises ValueError

acceptance_criteria.description: assemble_prompt(stage: Literal['planning','examination','attribution'], problem_statement: ProblemStatement, candidate_set: CandidateSet, investigation_state: InvestigationState | None = None, brief: InvestigationBrief | None = None, evidence: list[str] | None = None, config: PromptConfig | None = None) → str. Invalid stage raises ValueError. Returns ordered multi-section prompt string with sections separated by a blank line.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: call with stage='planning', minimal ProblemStatement and CandidateSet; returns non-empty string; split on double-newline blocks; stage='invalid' raises ValueError

acceptance_criteria.description: Up to 10 sections in strict order when populated. Exact headers: (1) `## System Role`, (2) `## Hard Rules ({Stage})` where Stage is Planning|Examination|Attribution (title-cased from stage param), (3) `## Soft Rules ({Stage})`, (4) `## Relevant Skills`, (5) `## Stage Instructions`, (6) `## Problem Statement`, (7) `## Candidate Summary` or `## Candidate Summary (top N of M)` when N<M commits shown, (8) `## Investigation Progress`, (9) `## Investigation Brief`, (10) `## Evidence Collected`. Regex extraction of `^## .+` lines preserves this order among present sections.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: assemble with all sections populated; extract section headers via regex; verify exact strings and order match spec including Hard Rules (Examination) and Candidate Summary (top N of M)

acceptance_criteria.description: Empty sections omitted entirely — no header, no blank placeholder. Sections 8–9 only for stages examination/attribution AND only when investigation_state (§8) or brief (§9) is not None respectively. Section 10 only for attribution when evidence is non-empty list.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: stage='planning' → no sections 8–10; stage='examination' with state=None → no section 8; brief=None → no section 9; stage='attribution' with evidence=[] → no section 10

acceptance_criteria.description: System Role section (1) contains stage-specific role text including substring 'Planning stage'|'Examination stage'|'Attribution stage' matching stage param, and includes 'bug attribution investigator' (case-insensitive).
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: each stage produces distinct system_role text containing the stage name phrase and 'bug attribution investigator'

acceptance_criteria.description: Hard Rules section (2) calls load_rules(stage) and renders each hard rule as bullet `- {rule.description}` (one per line). Soft Rules section (3) renders each soft rule's prompt_text verbatim (preserving internal newlines). Either section omitted when corresponding rule list empty.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test with mocked load_rules returning 1 hard + 1 soft rule: hard description appears as `- {description}`; soft prompt_text appears verbatim; empty hard list omits section 2

acceptance_criteria.description: Skills section (4) calls retrieve_skills(problem_statement, top_k=config.max_skills). Each skill rendered as `### {skill.id}` followed by skill.body on subsequent lines. Skills appear in retrieve_skills return order (score descending). Section omitted when retrieve_skills returns empty.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test with mocked retrieve_skills returning 2 skills in score order: both appear under ### headers with body text in same order

acceptance_criteria.description: Stage Instructions section (5) contains stage-specific task instructions. Planning MUST include 'InvestigationBrief' and 'JSON'. Examination MUST include 'examine' and 'evidence' (case-insensitive). Attribution MUST include 'rank' and 'confidence' (case-insensitive). Text differs across the three stages.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: each stage output contains required substrings; pairwise stage instruction bodies are not identical

acceptance_criteria.description: Candidate Summary section (7) formats commits sorted by rank ascending as numbered lines: `{rank}. {commit_id[:12]} — "{summary}" — {files_changed joined with ', '}'`. Selection: planning — first config.candidate_limit_stage2 by rank; examination — examined commits (first min(candidates_examined, len(commits)) by rank) plus next config.candidate_limit_stage3_unexamined unexamined by rank; attribution — examined commits only (same first-N-by-rank rule). Header uses `(top N of M)` when N<M total commits in candidate_set.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: planning with 30 candidates → 20 lines + header `(top 20 of 30)`; examination with candidates_examined=5 and 15 commits → 5 examined + 5 unexamined lines; attribution with candidates_examined=3 → exactly 3 lines

acceptance_criteria.description: Truncation policy per ADR §Q3: estimate tokens as len(full_text)//4. When estimated > config.token_budget * config.truncation_threshold, apply cascade until under threshold or exhausted: (1) evidence — remove entries from index 0 (oldest) one at a time; (2) candidate_summary — keep top 10 by rank; (3) skills — keep top 1. Never truncate content in sections 1–6 (system_role, hard_rules, soft_rules, stage_instructions, problem_statement). Re-estimate after each cascade step.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: token_budget=400, threshold=0.80, large evidence + 30 candidates + 3 skills → evidence removed first (FIFO), then candidates capped to 10, then skills to 1; problem_statement Title line always present; hard_rules and stage_instructions unchanged

acceptance_criteria.description: Investigation Progress section (8) when investigation_state is not None and stage is examination or attribution: single line `Stage: {current_stage}, Examined: {candidates_examined}/{candidates_total}, Hypotheses tested: {hypotheses_tested}, confirmed: {hypotheses_confirmed}, Evidence quotes: {evidence_quotes_collected}`.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: InvestigationState with known field values on examination stage → progress line matches exact format

acceptance_criteria.description: Investigation Brief section (9) renders json.dumps(brief.to_dict(), indent=2) inside section when brief is not None and stage is examination or attribution.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: brief with 2 hypotheses on examination stage → JSON block contains hypothesis ids/statements

acceptance_criteria.description: Evidence Collected section (10) on attribution when evidence non-empty: numbered list `{i}. {quote}` starting at 1, preserving evidence list order.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: stage='attribution', evidence=['quote1','quote2'] → lines `1. quote1` and `2. quote2` under section header

acceptance_criteria.description: Package isolation: prompt_assembler.py imports only from commit_investigator.governance.rules, commit_investigator.governance.skills (or relative .rules/.skills), commit_investigator.extraction (ProblemStatement), commit_investigator.models (CandidateSet, CandidateCommit, InvestigationState, InvestigationBrief), and stdlib. Zero imports from agent/, eval/, infra/.
prompt_assembler.py ≤ 300 lines. governance/__init__.py updated to export assemble_prompt and PromptConfig in __all__.
acceptance_criteria.verification: wc -l on prompt_assembler.py ≤ 300; __all__ includes assemble_prompt and PromptConfig

acceptance_criteria.description: tests/test_prompt_assembler.py with ≥22 tests covering all ACs and edge cases. pytest tests/ passes with zero regressions (260+ existing tests).
acceptance_criteria.verification: pytest tests/ --ignore=tests/_v2_archive exits 0; test_prompt_assembler.py exists with ≥22 tests

acceptance_criteria.description: Problem Statement section (6) body format per ADR §Q3 example: `Title: {title}`, `Description: {description}` on separate lines; when extracted_files non-empty append `Extracted files: {comma-space joined}`; when extracted_keywords non-empty append `Extracted keywords: {comma-space joined}`. Must NOT embed `## Bug Report` nested header from ProblemStatement.to_prompt_text(). Section omitted when problem_statement.is_empty is True.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test: ProblemStatement with title, description, files, keywords → section contains all four label lines without `## Bug Report`; is_empty True → no `## Problem Statement` header

acceptance_criteria.description: Integration wiring without mocks: assemble_prompt(stage='examination', ProblemStatement with any keywords, CandidateSet with ≥1 commit) invokes real load_rules/retrieve_skills against seed data/governance/. Output includes `## Hard Rules (Examination)` with `- {continue_below_confidence.description}` and `## Soft Rules (Examination)` containing substring from parent_chain_examine.prompt_text in seed YAML.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Integration test against DEFAULT_RULES_DIR seed files (skip if seed missing): examination prompt contains both rule sections with seed rule content

Hard rule enforcement at stage transitions (v4-investigation-harness P7)
Token counting via tiktoken or similar (len//4 approximation is sufficient for V4)
PromptAssembler class wrapper — assemble_prompt function satisfies ADR §Q3 assembly algorithm
